# Yumingxing

> Stainless steel cutlery and kitchen utensils for international wholesalers, importers and private-label buyers. Based in Jieyang, Guangdong, China.

## Company

Brand: Yumingxing / 裕明兴. Chinese company name: 揭阳市裕明兴五金制品有限公司. English company name: Jieyang Yumingxing Hardware Co., Ltd. Unified Social Credit Code: 91445200MA529NQG6E.

The brand and factory business began in 2003. This describes the operating history, not the legal incorporation date of the current limited company.

## Product information

Read specifications by model and component. A series-level material label does not mean every component has the same grade. MOQ quantity and unit, sample availability, delivery terms and test documents are confirmed for the intended order. Manufacturing images illustrate processes; they do not establish third-party certification or brand authorization.
